context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 下っ/膨らま/別物/呼べる/挙動/利き/積もっ/引き込ま

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、ゼミでは下っ端、まだ、君もな。
lines.en: Sakura — you're still a junior in the seminar, same as everyone starting out.
lines.style: Casual, slightly teasing senpai tone. Relaxed opening. Matter-of-fact delivery with the warmth of someone who remembers being where she is.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、自信を膨らませる手伝い、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for helping me build confidence, Senpai.
lines.style: Genuinely grateful, but with underlying self-awareness. Soft respectful tone. A slight pause before 'thank you' — not rote politeness, but meant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学部論文と修論、別物だぞ。
lines.en: An undergraduate thesis and a master's thesis are completely different animals.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact instruction. Light emphasis on the distinction. The tone of someone who's already been through this — not warning, informing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、いつでも呼べる存在で、ありがたいです。
lines.en: I'm really grateful that you're someone I can always call on, Senpai.
lines.style: Warm and sincere beneath the formal register. Slight hesitation before committing to the compliment — she means it but isn't used to saying it out loud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近、お前の挙動、自信ついてきたな。
lines.en: Your confidence has grown noticeably these days.
lines.style: Observant, almost musing. Quiet approval in the observation. A small nod in the voice — he's noticed something shift in her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、利き手、右ですよね。
lines.en: Yes. Your dominant hand is your right, isn't it, Senpai?
lines.style: Curious, slightly tentative question. She's testing something — a genuine inquiry but with a thread of purpose underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論文の参考文献、たくさん積もったな。
lines.en: The references for your paper have really piled up.
lines.style: Observing aloud, almost to himself. Slight warmth — acknowledging the work. Slower pace, the tone of someone tracking her progress.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩の論考に、引き込まれます、いつも。
lines.en: Yes. I'm always drawn in by your essays, Senpai.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Formal register but genuine underneath. Soft, almost tender close — she's saying something more than the words.
